description: Load or clear the sample data: a small example inventory (categories, places, people, items and a few tickets, all marked as samples) for a new organization to look around in. action "add" loads it; while it is loaded a second add changes nothing. packKey picks the set (absent = the set that fits this organization). Sample items do not count against the item allowance. action "remove" deletes exactly the sample records, including ones edited since they were loaded, and nothing restores them as they were; records the organization created stay, and a sample category or place that its own records use is archived instead. A big set finishes removing in the background (outcome "removing"). Owner only.

action.description: add = load the sample set, remove = delete it again

packKey.description: Only for add: which sample set; absent = the set that fits this organization

name: sample_data

outcome.description: added | alreadyActive | notOffered (this organization's own showcase set was removed; nothing else is offered) | removing (continues in the background) | removed | notActive (there was nothing to remove)

packKey.description: Which sample set is loaded (custom = the organization's own showcase content)

sampleDataActive.description: Whether sample records are loaded after this call

webUrl.description: Link to the items list in the web app, where the sample items show

title: Add or remove sample data
